grader.scenario: Bill shock after child downloaded games over mobile data hotspot while abroad
grader.notes: International data roaming bill shock call handled by Paige. Customer incurred £420 in roaming charges after child tethered a Nintendo Switch in Turkey. Agent paraphrased well and re-rated charges down to £60, but failed 5 criteria: Branding (closing omitted), Active Listening (repeat question on country/charge), Professionalism (rude remark about parenting), Probing (omitted roaming cap/network checks), and Confirmed Resolved (cut off caller at closing).
